note: Issue #60. A Colorado-shaped state return: page 1 carries the state-titled return line, form number and department banner; page 2 prints only the form number and classifies UNKNOWN by construction, so it is ABSORBED into page 1's document as a continuation (absorbed_untyped_pages = 1). The refund rung lives on that absorbed page - proof that a continuation's content reaches extraction. The schema is deliberately thin (year, federal taxable income carry-in, refund): state captions are Colorado's, and only the year is required.
